title.zh: 安全提醒：PPV2漏洞攻击仍在持续，用户应立即撤销相关授权

current_state.zh: Yuga Labs' blockchain VP warns that the Payment Processor V2 (PPV2) approval exploit is still draining assets, citing a new victim who lost 0.15246 WETH within one block of accepting an offer, and urges users to immediately revoke outstanding approvals.
